title: Myocardial scar burden independently predicts response to cardiac resynchronization therapy
summary: Objectives: Cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) has been shown to improve quality of life and reduce mortality in patients with heart failure.Around 30 -45% are non-responders to CRT.Determinants of response to CRT have been extensively studied.Faithful efforts were exerted to improve selection criteria for CRT beyond standard measures of electrical dyssynchrony.We aimed to assess the predictive value of amount and distribution of myocardial fibrosis to identify responders to CRT compared to conventional measures.Methodology: 58 patients who underwent CRT implantation on the basis of standard indication were studied.All patients had available myocardial imaging (cardiac MRI or nuclear scan) prior to CRT.Images were analyzed for scar quantification and distribution.Multiple variables were studied.Receiver operator characteristic (ROC) curve analysis was used to evaluate the ability of Global scar to predict response to CRT.Results: 30 patients of 58 were non-responders to CRT. 27 patients had non-ischemic cardiomyopathy, while 31 patients had ischemic cardiomyopathy.19 patients (70.3%) in the non-ischemic group, and 9 patients (32.2%) in the ischemic group were responders to CRT, with a statistically significant difference, p-value: 0.002.A cutoff threshold of myocardial scar at 22.9% independently predicted response to CRT with a sensitivity of 70% and a specificity of 92.9%.Conclusion: Global myocardial scar burden predicted response to CRT independent of etiology, regional distribution, and measures of electrical dyssynchrony.

结论：整体心肌瘢痕负荷可独立于病因、区域分布和电学失同步指标预测CRT应答。

title: Safety and Outcomes of Percutaneous Vegetation Aspiration During Transvenous Lead Extraction: A Multicenter Experience.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Transvenous lead extraction (TLE) for cardiac implantable electronic device infection has high procedural success, but with a 1-year mortality approaching 25%. Potential mechanisms include septic embolization and persistent infected lead casts or "ghosts." Percutaneous mechanical aspiration of lead-related vegetations during TLE is a potential strategy to reduce vegetation burden, but safety and outcomes data are limited.

OBJECTIVES: To describe a multicenter experience utilizing percutaneous vegetation aspiration during TLE, including vegetation characteristics, procedural techniques, complications, and outcomes.

METHODS: A retrospective multicenter registry included patients undergoing aspiration of lead-related masses at the time of TLE between 2016 and 2024 across six institutions. Clinical, microbiologic, and procedural data were collected. Vegetation size and outcomes were assessed using transesophageal or intracardiac echocardiography.

RESULTS: Fifty-three patients (62 ± 14 years, 28% female) underwent aspiration of 63 vegetations during extraction of 114 leads (mean dwell time 9.0 ± 8.2 years). Indications included bacteremia in 44 (83%), fungemia in 4 (8%), fever of unknown origin in 1 (2%), and aseptic thrombus debulking in 4 (8%). Mean vegetation size was 2.8 ± 1.8 cm. Aspiration devices included Penumbra Indigo (34%), Inari FlowTriever (30%), and AngioVac (36%). Complete aspiration occurred in 40 patients (75%). TLE achieved complete success in 49 (92%) and clinical success in 52 (98%). Major complications related to aspiration occurred in 2 patients (4%). After a median follow-up of 139 days, 10 patients (19%) died.

CONCLUSIONS: Percutaneous vegetation aspiration during TLE appears feasible and generally safe. However, mortality following extraction for device-related infection remains substantial, and the impact of adjunctive aspiration on outcomes requires further study.

背景：因心脏植入式电子装置感染而进行的经静脉导线拔除（TLE）具有较高的手术成功率，但1年死亡率接近25%。潜在机制包括脓毒性栓塞和残留的感染导线管型或“鬼影”。在TLE过程中经皮机械抽吸导线相关赘生物是减轻赘生物负荷的潜在策略，但安全性和结局数据有限。

目的：描述在TLE过程中使用经皮赘生物抽吸的多中心经验，包括赘生物特征、手术技术、并发症和结局。

title: Prognostic Value of the C-Reactive Protein-to-Albumin Ratio in Patients Hospitalized with Atrioventricular Block: Association with In-Hospital Mortality and Temporary Pacemaker Requirement
summary: Background and Objectives: The C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) is an available marker of inflammatory–nutritional vulnerability, but its prognostic value in atrioventricular (AV) block is unclear. We investigated whether CAR is associated with in-hospital mortality and temporary pacemaker requirement (TPR) in hospitalized AV block. Materials and Methods: The study included 698 adults hospitalized with second-degree or higher AV block between January 2012 and July 2020. CAR was calculated from admission C-reactive protein and albumin levels. The primary endpoint was in-hospital mortality, and the secondary endpoint was TPR. Results: In-hospital mortality occurred in 14.5% of patients, and TPR occurred in 33.7%. CAR was higher in non-survivors than survivors (0.51 [0.13–1.85] vs. 0.13 [0.05–0.45], p < 0.001) and in patients with TPR than those without TPR (0.29 [0.09–1.10] vs. 0.13 [0.05–0.41], p < 0.001). Mortality increased across CAR quartiles from 3.8% to 27.7%, and TPR increased from 19.7% to 48.0%. In adjusted models, ln(1 + CAR) was independently associated with mortality (OR 2.14, 95% CI 1.44–3.19; p < 0.001) and TPR (OR 1.99, 95% CI 1.38–2.86; p < 0.001). Adding CAR modestly improved discrimination for mortality (0.751 to 0.782; p = 0.020) and TPR (0.623 to 0.671; p < 0.001), without clear superiority over its individual components. Conclusions: CAR was independently associated with in-hospital mortality and TPR in hospitalized AV block.

AI.tldr: 在698例住院二度及以上房室传导阻滞患者中，C反应蛋白/白蛋白比值（CAR）与院内死亡和临时起搏器需求独立相关，但预测增益有限。

AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2012年1月至2020年7月住院的698例二度及以上房室传导阻滞成人患者。计算入院时CAR。主要终点为院内死亡，次要终点为临时起搏器需求（TPR）。采用多因素回归分析CAR与终点的关联，并评估其对死亡和TPR的判别能力。
AI.conclusion: CAR与住院房室传导阻滞患者的院内死亡和临时起搏器需求独立相关，可作为风险分层辅助指标，但其预测增益有限，临床价值需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 背景与目的：C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值（CAR）是一种可获得的炎症-营养脆弱性标志物，但其在房室（AV）传导阻滞中的预后价值尚不明确。我们研究了CAR是否与住院AV传导阻滞患者的院内死亡率和临时起搏器需求（TPR）相关。材料与方法：研究纳入2012年1月至2020年7月期间因二度或更高程度AV传导阻滞住院的698例成人患者。CAR由入院时C反应蛋白和白蛋白水平计算得出。主要终点为院内死亡率，次要终点为TPR。结果：14.5%的患者发生院内死亡，33.7%的患者发生TPR。非存活者的CAR高于存活者（0.51 [0.13–1.85] vs. 0.13 [0.05–0.45]，p < 0.001），发生TPR的患者CAR高于未发生TPR者（0.29 [0.09–1.10] vs. 0.13 [0.05–0.41]，p < 0.001）。死亡率随CAR四分位数升高从3.8%增至27.7%，TPR从19.7%增至48.0%。在调整模型中，ln(1 + CAR)与死亡率（OR 2.14，95% CI 1.44–3.19；p < 0.001）和TPR（OR 1.99，95% CI 1.38–2.86；p < 0.001）独立相关。加入CAR对死亡率的区分度（0.751至0.782；p = 0.020）和TPR的区分度（0.623至0.671；p < 0.001）有适度改善，但与其各单独组分相比无明显优势。结论：CAR与住院AV传导阻滞患者的院内死亡率和TPR独立相关。

Advances in Biodegradable Supercapacitors for Implantable Bioelectronics: Materials, Energy Storage, Degradation, and Clinical Translation
summary: The emergence of transient bioelectronics has accelerated the development of biodegradable supercapacitors as promising energy-storage systems for temporary medical implants, including neural stimulators, cardiac pacemakers, controlled drug delivery devices, and biosensors. Biodegradable supercapacitors can safely resorb after completing their function, eliminating secondary surgical removal and reducing long-term foreign-body complications, unlike conventional batteries. This review comprehensively discusses recent advances in degradable supercapacitors, focusing on biocompatible polymers, bioresorbable electrodes, separators, electrolytes, and current collectors. This review critically evaluates the electrochemical performance of biodegradable supercapacitors under physiological conditions, including capacitance retention, cycling stability, and degradation behaviour. Current challenges, such as limited energy density, mechanical instability, precise bioresorption kinetics, and scalability, are discussed. This study addresses key regulatory and safety considerations, including biocompatibility, toxicity, immunogenicity, and pathway approval. Further, outlines strategic future directions: bio-derived carbon, biologically synthesized conductors, self-healing hydrogel electrolytes, stimulus-responsive programmable degradation, and energy-harvesting integration. Emerging frontiers at the intersection of bioelectronics, neuromorphic computing, and living devices, and advocates for standardized benchmarking and circular-economy integration. This comprehensive analysis aims to accelerate the rational design, validation, and clinical translation of degradable supercapacitors toward autonomous, patient-friendly implantable systems.

summary_zh: 瞬态生物电子的出现加速了可生物降解超级电容器的发展，使其成为临时医疗植入物（包括神经刺激器、心脏起搏器、受控药物递送装置和生物传感器）有前景的储能系统。与传统电池不同，可生物降解超级电容器在完成功能后可安全吸收，无需二次手术移除，并减少长期异物并发症。本综述全面讨论了可降解超级电容器的最新进展，重点关注生物相容性聚合物、生物可吸收电极、隔膜、电解质和集流体。本综述批判性地评估了可生物降解超级电容器在生理条件下的电化学性能，包括电容保持率、循环稳定性和降解行为。讨论了当前挑战，如有限能量密度、机械不稳定性、精确的生物吸收动力学和可扩展性。本研究探讨了关键监管和安全考虑，包括生物相容性、毒性、免疫原性和通路批准。进一步概述了战略未来方向：生物衍生碳、生物合成导体、自修复水凝胶电解质、刺激响应可编程降解和能量收集集成。生物电子学、神经形态计算和活体设备交叉领域的新兴前沿，并倡导标准化基准和循环经济整合。这一综合分析旨在加速可降解超级电容器的合理设计、验证和临床转化，以实现自主、患者友好的植入系统。

title: Step-By-Step Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing: A Practical Technical Guide.
summary: Left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) has emerged as a physiological pacing strategy capable of restoring ventricular synchrony in patients requiring permanent pacing or cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT). Compared with conventional right ventricular pacing and biventricular pacing, LBBAP provides more physiological ventricular activation by engaging the His-Purkinje conduction system. However, procedural success depends heavily on appropriate patient selection, anatomical targeting, and standardized implantation techniques. This technical review aims to provide a comprehensive, step-by-step guide to LBBAP implantation by integrating electrocardiographic, fluoroscopic, and intracardiac electrophysiological criteria consistent with current European Heart Rhythm Association (EHRA) and Heart Rhythm Society (HRS) recommendations. It summarizes the procedural workflow, patient selection criteria, implantation techniques, electrocardiographic markers, septal penetration strategies, and pacing confirmation parameters based on selected implantation cases supported by annotated electrocardiograms (ECGs), filtered and unfiltered electrograms (EGMs), and fluoroscopic images. Key procedural elements associated with successful LBBAP include systematic evaluation of the interventricular septal anatomy, continuous 12-lead ECG monitoring, precise fluoroscopic targeting, and electrophysiological confirmation of conduction system capture. Important procedural indicators include a W-pattern morphology in lead V1 and aVR-aVL discordance before septal penetration, fixation beats during septal penetration, a terminal r/R wave in lead V1, the V6 R-wave peak time, V6-V1 interpeak interval measurements, and demonstration of selective or nonselective left bundle branch capture or left ventricular septal capture after septal penetration. When performed using standardized implantation criteria and electrophysiological validation, LBBAP represents a reproducible and effective physiological pacing technique for both bradycardia indications and CRT candidates. The adoption of standardized procedural terminology and validation criteria may improve procedural success and clinical outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本技术综述系统阐述了左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）的标准化植入流程与电生理验证标准，强调规范操作可提高手术成功率和临床结局。

title: Adjuvant Radiotherapy for Early Breast Cancer in a Patient with a Cardiac Pacemaker Near the Radiation Field: A Case Report
summary: Background and Objectives: A patient with a permanent cardiac pacemaker requiring adjuvant breast radiotherapy poses a major challenge given the risk of device damage, requiring careful treatment planning.Case presentation: We report a 76-year-old woman with hypertension and hypothyroidism, with a pacemaker implanted after mitral valve surgery on a left side, diagnosed with left breast cancer. Following lumpectomy and sentinel lymph node biopsy, histopathology confirmed invasive ductal carcinoma, grade II, 20×18×16 mm (pT1c), with a DCIS component (~5%). Due to Ki67 40%, the tumor was classified luminal B (HER2-low) (ER 25%, PR 5%, HER2 2+, Dual-SISH negative), node-negative (0/2). The tumor board recommended adjuvant anastrozole and postoperative radiotherapy of the breast. A simultaneous integrated boost technique delivered 42.4 Gy in 16 fractions with a boost up to 48 Gy to the tumor bed, using 6–10 MV photon beams. Constraints for cardiac implantable electronic devices were succesfully met (photon energy ≤10 MV; pacemaker dose <2 Gy) with maximum pacemaker dose of 200.8 cGy and mean dose of 44.2 cGy. Cardiology clearance was obtained and treatment was safely initiated and well tolerated.Conclusions: In elderly patients with low-risk, hormone-sensitive disease, omitting radiotherapy is acceptable, but not for high-Ki67 tumors, which carry greater biological risk. Radiotherapy was therefore justified despite the pacemaker. Mastectomy avoids radiotherapy but offers no survival benefit in early-stage disease, and partial irradiation was not considered due to tumor biology. Careful radiotherapy planning within established constraints, enables safe adjuvant radiotherapy, including an integrated boost, even when a pacemaker lies close to the radiation field.

AI.tldr: 76岁左乳腺癌伴左侧心脏起搏器患者，通过严格放疗计划使起搏器最大剂量200.8 cGy、平均44.2 cGy，安全完成保乳术后同步整合推量放疗。
AI.motivation: 永久起搏器患者需辅助乳腺放疗时，起搏器可能位于照射野附近，存在设备损坏风险，需谨慎制定治疗计划。对于低危激素敏感老年患者可考虑省略放疗，但高Ki67肿瘤生物学风险高，放疗仍有必要。
AI.method: 病例报告。76岁女性，高血压、甲状腺功能减退，二尖瓣术后左侧植入永久起搏器，确诊左乳腺癌。保乳术及前哨淋巴结活检后病理为浸润性导管癌II级，20×18×16 mm（pT1c），伴约5%导管原位癌成分，Ki67 40%，Luminal B（HER2低表达），淋巴结阴性（0/2）。肿瘤委员会建议辅助阿那曲唑及术后乳腺放疗。采用同步整合推量技术，6–10 MV光子束，16次给予42.4 Gy，瘤床推量至48 Gy。起搏器约束：光子能量≤10 MV，起搏器剂量<2 Gy。
AI.result: 起搏器约束成功满足，最大剂量200.8 cGy，平均剂量44.2 cGy。获得心脏科许可后治疗安全启动且耐受良好。摘要未报告随访疗效及起搏器功能随访数据。
AI.conclusion: 对于起搏器靠近照射野的早期乳腺癌患者，在既定约束下精心放疗计划可安全实施辅助放疗，包括同步整合推量。但本结果为单例病例报告，缺乏长期安全性和疗效数据，需个体化评估。

summary_zh: 背景与目的：一名需要辅助乳腺放疗的永久性心脏起搏器患者面临重大挑战，因为存在设备损坏的风险，需要仔细的治疗计划。病例介绍：我们报告一名76岁女性，患有高血压和甲状腺功能减退症，二尖瓣手术后左侧植入起搏器，诊断为左乳腺癌。在肿块切除术和前哨淋巴结活检后，组织病理学证实为浸润性导管癌，II级，20×18×16 mm（pT1c），伴有导管原位癌成分（约5%）。由于Ki67 40%，肿瘤被分类为luminal B（HER2-low）（ER 25%，PR 5%，HER2 2+，Dual-SISH阴性），淋巴结阴性（0/2）。肿瘤委员会建议辅助阿那曲唑和术后乳腺放疗。采用同步整合推量技术，16次分割给予42.4 Gy，瘤床推量至48 Gy，使用6–10 MV光子束。成功满足心脏植入式电子设备的限制（光子能量≤10 MV；起搏器剂量<2 Gy），起搏器最大剂量为200.8 cGy，平均剂量为44.2 cGy。获得心脏病学许可，治疗安全启动且耐受良好。结论：在患有低风险、激素敏感性疾病的老年患者中，省略放疗是可接受的，但对于高Ki67肿瘤则不然，后者具有更大的生物学风险。因此，尽管有起搏器，放疗是合理的。乳房切除术避免了放疗，但在早期疾病中没有生存获益，并且由于肿瘤生物学，未考虑部分照射。在既定限制内仔细的放疗计划，使得安全的辅助放疗成为可能，包括整合推量，即使起搏器靠近辐射野。

title: Fluoroless Ablation of a Coronary Sinus-related Accessory Pathway Without Coronary Sinus Angiogram in a Patient with Multiple Prior Failed Ablations.
summary: Accessory pathways (APs) associated with the coronary sinus (CS), often linked to diverticula, are rare and challenging to ablate, frequently requiring CS venography for anatomical guidance. We report the case of a 56-year-old woman with recurrent palpitations, manifest pre-excitation, and two prior failed ablations for a presumed posteroseptal pathway. The electrocardiogram showed an immediately negative QRS complex in the inferior leads, suggesting an epicardial CS-related pathway. Using solely three-dimensional (3D) electroanatomic mapping (CARTO™; J&J MedTech, New Brunswick, NJ, USA) without fluoroscopy or CS angiogram, we reconstructed the geometry of the right atrium, venae cavae, and CS. Mapping revealed early ventricular activation and fused atrioventricular signals in distal CS, enabling successful radiofrequency ablation at 30 W with immediate loss of antegrade conduction. No retrograde conduction persisted post-adenosine, and tachycardia was non-inducible. The patient remained symptom-free at 1-year follow-up. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first reported successful fluoroless ablation of a CS-related epicardial AP without venography, highlighting the role of advanced 3D mapping in reducing radiation and contrast risks in complex cases.

AI.tldr: 一例多次消融失败的冠状静脉窦相关心外膜旁路患者，仅用三维电解剖标测无透视无静脉造影成功消融，1年随访无复发。
AI.motivation: 冠状静脉窦相关旁路常与憩室相关，罕见且消融困难，通常需冠状静脉窦静脉造影指导解剖定位；既往多次消融失败病例的再次消融策略及减少辐射和对比剂风险的方法尚缺乏证据。
AI.method: 病例报告。56岁女性，反复心悸、显性预激，既往两次针对推测后间隔旁路的消融失败。心电图下壁导联QRS波起始即负向，提示心外膜冠状静脉窦相关旁路。仅使用三维电解剖标测系统（CARTO）无透视、无冠状静脉窦造影重建右心房、腔静脉和冠状静脉窦几何结构，标测发现冠状静脉窦远端提前心室激动和房室信号融合，以30 W射频消融。终点为旁路前向传导消失、腺苷后无逆向传导及心动过速不可诱发。
AI.result: 消融后前向传导立即消失，腺苷后无逆向传导，心动过速不可诱发。1年随访患者无症状，无复发。摘要未报告具体标测时间、辐射剂量和对比剂用量。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首例无透视、无静脉造影成功消融冠状静脉窦相关心外膜旁路的报道，凸显先进三维标测在复杂病例中减少辐射和对比剂风险的作用。作为单例病例报告，结论需更多病例验证，但为多次消融失败的后间隔旁路提供了无透视无造影的可行策略。

summary_zh: 与冠状静脉窦（CS）相关的旁路（AP）常与憩室相关，罕见且消融困难，通常需要冠状静脉窦静脉造影进行解剖定位。我们报告一例56岁女性，反复心悸，显性预激，既往两次针对推测的后间隔旁路消融失败。心电图显示下壁导联QRS波群起始即呈负向，提示心外膜CS相关旁路。仅使用三维（3D）电解剖标测系统（CARTO™；J&J MedTech，New Brunswick，NJ，USA），未使用透视或CS造影，我们重建了右心房、腔静脉和CS的几何结构。标测显示CS远端心室激动提前，房室信号融合，从而成功以30 W射频消融，前向传导立即消失。腺苷后无逆行传导，心动过速不可诱发。患者随访1年无症状。据我们所知，这是首例报道的成功无透视、无静脉造影消融CS相关心外膜旁路的病例，突显了先进3D标测在减少复杂病例辐射和造影剂风险中的作用。

title: Atrial fibrillation in allogeneic and autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients: incidence and clinical implications
summary: Abstract Introduction Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common acute cardiovascular complication following hematopoietic cell transplant (HCT). However, the incidence and risk factors for early-onset AF post-HCT remain poorly understood. Methods A retrospective cohort study was conducted to assess the onset and risk factors of AF within 90 days post-HCT in 5,965 adult transplant recipients. Patients underwent either allogeneic HCT (alloHCT, n = 2,742) or autologous HCT (autoHCT, n = 3,223) between January 1st, 2010 and December 31st, 2023. Cumulative incidence curves and Gray’s tests were used to assess AF cumulative incidence. Fine-Gary proportional sub-distributional hazard models were applied to estimate associations between factors and AF risk. Results Among patients without prior arrhythmia, cardiac disease, or valvular heart disease, AF occurred more frequently in alloHCT recipients than in autoHCT recipients (6.3% vs. 4.3%, Gray’s test P < 0.001). The median age was 54 years (range: 18–82) for alloHCT and 59 years (range: 18–78) for autoHCT. In alloHCT recipients, increased AF risk was associated with older age (≥ 50 vs. <50 years, adjusted hazard ratio (HR) = 2.85, P < 0.0001) and lower Karnofsky performance score (KPS, < 80 vs. ≥80, adjusted HR = 1.69, P = 0.03). In autoHCT recipients, increased AF risk was associated with older age (adjusted HR = 2.49, P = 0.006), lower KPS (adjusted HR = 2.41, P = 0.0001) and obesity (adjusted HR = 1.68, P = 0.015). Conclusion(s) This study indicates that AF cumulative incidence within 90 days post-HCT is higher in alloHCT than in autoHCT patients. Transplant recipients with older age, lower KPS, or obesity have an increased risk for early onset of AF post-HCT.

AI.tldr: 在无既往心律失常、心脏病或瓣膜病的成人移植受者中，异基因HCT后90天内AF累积发生率高于自体HCT（6.3% vs 4.3%，P<0.001），高龄、低KPS及肥胖为危险因素。
AI.motivation: AF是造血干细胞移植后最常见的急性心血管并发症，但移植后早期（90天内）AF的发生率及危险因素尚不明确，既往证据有限，缺乏大样本、区分异基因与自体移植的研究。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2010年1月1日至2023年12月31日期间接受移植的5,965例成人受者，其中异基因HCT 2,742例、自体HCT 3,223例；主要终点为移植后90天内新发AF；采用累积发生率曲线与Gray检验比较发生率，并以Fine-Gray竞争风险模型估计危险因素与AF风险的关联。
AI.result: 在无既往心律失常、心脏病或瓣膜病的患者中，异基因HCT组AF发生率高于自体HCT组（6.3% vs 4.3%，Gray检验P<0.001）。异基因HCT组中位年龄54岁（18–82），自体HCT组59岁（18–78）。异基因HCT组AF风险与高龄（≥50 vs <50岁，校正HR=2.85，P<0.0001）及低KPS（<80 vs ≥80，校正HR=1.69，P=0.03）相关；自体HCT组AF风险与高龄（校正HR=2.49，P=0.006）、低KPS（校正HR=2.41，P=0.0001）及肥胖（校正HR=1.68，P=0.015）相关。
AI.conclusion: 移植后90天内AF累积发生率异基因HCT高于自体HCT，高龄、低KPS及肥胖（仅自体HCT）为早期AF的危险因素。提示临床应对高危移植受者加强心律监测与心血管风险管理；本研究为回顾性设计，摘要未报告AF相关临床结局及多中心外部验证，结论需前瞻性研究进一步确认。

summary_zh: 摘要 引言：心房颤动（AF）是造血细胞移植（HCT）后最常见的急性心血管并发症。然而，HCT后早发性AF的发病率和危险因素仍知之甚少。方法：进行了一项回顾性队列研究，以评估5,965名成年移植受者HCT后90天内AF的发生和危险因素。患者在2010年1月1日至2023年12月31日期间接受了异基因HCT（alloHCT，n = 2,742）或自体HCT（autoHCT，n = 3,223）。使用累积发病率曲线和Gray检验评估AF累积发病率。应用Fine-Gray比例亚分布风险模型估计因素与AF风险之间的关联。结果：在无既往心律失常、心脏病或瓣膜性心脏病的患者中，alloHCT受者的AF发生率高于autoHCT受者（6.3% vs. 4.3%，Gray检验P < 0.001）。alloHCT的中位年龄为54岁（范围：18–82），autoHCT为59岁（范围：18–78）。在alloHCT受者中，AF风险增加与年龄较大（≥ 50 vs. <50岁，调整风险比（HR）= 2.85，P < 0.0001）和较低的Karnofsky体能状态评分（KPS，< 80 vs. ≥80，调整HR = 1.69，P = 0.03）相关。在autoHCT受者中，AF风险增加与年龄较大（调整HR = 2.49，P = 0.006）、较低的KPS（调整HR = 2.41，P = 0.0001）和肥胖（调整HR = 1.68，P = 0.015）相关。结论：本研究表明，HCT后90天内AF累积发病率在alloHCT患者中高于autoHCT患者。年龄较大、KPS较低或肥胖的移植受者HCT后早发性AF风险增加。

title: Proteostatic regulation of hERG1 isoforms and LQT2 mutants by MKRN1
summary: Loss-of-function mutations in type 1 human ether-à-go-go-related gene (hERG1) potassium channels are associated with the ventricular arrhythmia type 2 long QT syndrome (LQT2). Most LQT2-causing missense mutations lead to impaired membrane trafficking and enhanced endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-associated degradation of hERG1. Multiple types of E3 ubiquitin ligases differentially mediate the degradation of misfolded mutant hERG1 proteins at the ER and plasma membrane, the molecular details of which remain poorly understood. Herein, we aim to elucidate the molecular mechanisms by which the E3 ubiquitin ligase makorin ring finger protein 1 (MKRN1) regulates the protein quality control of hERG1. Biochemical and immunofluorescence analyses were employed to study the effect of MKRN1 on hERG1 proteostasis in HEK293T cells, mouse HL-1 atrial cells, and mouse and rat heart tissues. Electrophysiological investigations were applied to examine the functional expression of hERG1. Molecular modeling was used to explore the interaction between MKRN1 and hERG1. We demonstrated that MKRN1 was a novel binding partner of two hERG1 isoforms (hERG1a, hERG1b), probably by interacting with the carboxyl-terminal region of both isoforms, as well as the amino-terminal region of hERG1a. MKRN1 downregulated total hERG1 protein level and potassium current density, mainly by enhancing the degradation of ER-localized core-glycosylated immature hERG1 through the ubiquitin-proteasome system. MKRN1 promoted the ER-associated degradation of the misfolded LQT2-causing hERG1 mutants A561V and G601S. Suppression of endogenous MKRN1 activity by RNA interference partially corrected the trafficking defect of the G601S mutant. Treatment with 1 µM ebastine, a clinically used antihistamine and recently demonstrated MKRN1 inhibitor, also rescued the forward trafficking of A561V and G601S, as well as increasing the potassium current density of G601S. 250 nM ebastine was sufficient to achieve near-maximal rescue of hERG1-G601S protein maturation and functional current. Ebastine produced little or no additional G601S rescue effect under MKRN1 knockdown conditions. These findings are consistent with the notion that MKRN1 regulates ER proteostasis of immature hERG1 proteins in cardiomyocytes, and plays an essential role in controlling the membrane trafficking of LQT2-causing hERG1 mutants. Our study highlights the therapeutic potential of ebastine in LQT2 patients.

AI.tldr: E3泛素连接酶MKRN1通过促进内质网相关降解下调hERG1蛋白及电流，并介导LQT2突变体A561V和G601S的转运缺陷；MKRN1抑制剂依巴斯汀可 rescue 突变体前向转运和电流。
AI.motivation: LQT2多由hERG1错义突变导致蛋白转运障碍和内质网相关降解增强，但不同E3泛素连接酶调控突变体质量控制的分子细节尚不清楚，缺乏靶向蛋白稳态的治疗策略。
AI.method: 基础研究。在HEK293T细胞、小鼠HL-1心房细胞及小鼠和大鼠心脏组织中，采用生化与免疫荧光分析MKRN1对hERG1蛋白稳态的影响，电生理检查hERG1功能表达，分子建模探索MKRN1与hERG1相互作用；并测试依巴斯汀对LQT2突变体A561V和G601S的 rescue 效应。
AI.result: MKRN1是hERG1a和hERG1b的新结合伙伴，可能通过两亚型羧基端及hERG1a氨基端相互作用。MKRN1下调总hERG1蛋白水平和钾电流密度，主要通过泛素-蛋白酶体系统增强内质网定位的核心糖基化未成熟hERG1降解。MKRN1促进错折叠LQT2突变体A561V和G601S的内质网相关降解；RNA干扰抑制内源MKRN1部分纠正G601S转运缺陷。1 µM依巴斯汀 rescue A561V和G601S前向转运并增加G601S钾电流密度，250 nM即达近最大 rescue；MKRN1敲低下依巴斯汀无额外 rescue 效应。
AI.conclusion: MKRN1调控心肌细胞未成熟hERG1的内质网蛋白稳态，对LQT2突变体膜转运至关重要；依巴斯汀作为MKRN1抑制剂可 rescue 突变体功能，提示其治疗LQT2的潜力。研究为细胞水平，临床转化需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 1型人类ether-à-go-go相关基因（hERG1）钾通道的功能丧失性突变与室性心律失常2型长QT综合征（LQT2）相关。大多数导致LQT2的错义突变导致膜转运受损和hERG1内质网（ER）相关降解增强。多种类型的E3泛素连接酶差异性地介导错误折叠的突变型hERG1蛋白在内质网和质膜的降解，其分子细节仍知之甚少。在此，我们旨在阐明E3泛素连接酶makorin环指蛋白1（MKRN1）调控hERG1蛋白质质量控制的分子机制。采用生化分析和免疫荧光分析研究MKRN1对HEK293T细胞、小鼠HL-1心房细胞以及小鼠和大鼠心脏组织中hERG1蛋白质稳态的影响。应用电生理学研究检查hERG1的功能性表达。使用分子建模探索MKRN1与hERG1之间的相互作用。我们证明MKRN1是两种hERG1亚型（hERG1a、hERG1b）的新型结合伴侣，可能通过与两种亚型的羧基末端区域以及hERG1a的氨基末端区域相互作用。MKRN1下调总hERG1蛋白水平和钾电流密度，主要通过泛素-蛋白酶体系统增强内质网定位的核心糖基化未成熟hERG1的降解。MKRN1促进错误折叠的LQT2相关hERG1突变体A561V和G601S的内质网相关降解。通过RNA干扰抑制内源性MKRN1活性部分纠正了G601S突变体的转运缺陷。用1 µM依巴斯汀（一种临床使用的抗组胺药，最近被证明是MKRN1抑制剂）处理也挽救了A561V和G601S的正向转运，并增加了G601S的钾电流密度。250 nM依巴斯汀足以实现hERG1-G601S蛋白成熟和功能性电流的近最大挽救。在MKRN1敲低条件下，依巴斯汀产生很少或没有额外的G601S挽救效应。这些发现与以下观点一致：MKRN1调节心肌细胞中未成熟hERG1蛋白的内质网蛋白质稳态，并在控制导致LQT2的hERG1突变体的膜转运中起重要作用。我们的研究强调了依巴斯汀在LQT2患者中的治疗潜力。

title: Temporal association between adjunctive repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation and seizure reduction in a pediatric patient with DNM1L-associated EMPF1: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Encephalopathy, lethal, due to defective mitochondrial and peroxisomal fission 1 (EMPF1) is a rare, severe mitochondrial disorder characterized by acute-onset refractory seizures that rapidly progress to status epilepticus and are associated with a poor prognosis. Conventional therapies, including antiepileptic drugs and the ketogenic diet, exhibit limited efficacy. Although repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in other forms of drug-resistant epilepsy, its potential role in managing EMPF1 remains unexplored.

CASE PRESENTATION: A 7-year-old boy, previously healthy with normal development, presented with right-hand clonic movements and impaired consciousness, which progressed to status epilepticus. Brain MRI revealed diffuse cytotoxic edema involving the bilateral frontal, parietal, and temporal cortices, basal ganglia, and thalami. EEG recording showed generalized periodic spike-wave discharges with background slowing. Genetic testing identified a novel de novo DNM1L mutation (c.1949T > C, p.Leu650Pro), which was classified as likely pathogenic according to ACMG/AMP guidelines and provided strong support for the diagnosis of EMPF1. In addition to a regimen of antiepileptic drugs and a metabolic "cocktail," 1-Hz rTMS (90% of the resting motor threshold, 40 trains daily) was applied over the left primary motor cortex on Day 16. Following initiation of this combined therapy, seizure frequency was temporally associated with a marked reduction, decreasing from ∼20 to 5-6 episodes/day after one day, 2-3 by Day 27 (12 days after rTMS initiation), and 0-1 by Day 36 (21 days after rTMS initiation). Despite this reduction in clinical seizure burden, the patient developed progressive pneumonia leading to sepsis and acute heart failure, and died on Day 65 (hospital day 65).

CONCLUSIONS: In this case, adjunctive rTMS applied alongside standard antiepileptic and metabolic "cocktail" therapy was temporally associated with a pronounced reduction in seizure frequency in a patient with DNM1L-associated EMPF1. This temporal association is hypothesis-generating and does not permit attribution of the observed seizure reduction to rTMS; further investigation in larger cohorts is warranted.

AI.tldr: 1例DNM1L相关EMPF1患儿在标准抗癫痫与代谢治疗基础上加用1Hz rTMS后，发作频率由约20次/日降至0-1次/日，但仅为时间关联，不能归因于rTMS。
AI.motivation: EMPF1是由线粒体与过氧化物酶体分裂缺陷所致的罕见严重线粒体病，表现为急性起病的难治性癫痫并迅速进展为癫痫持续状态，预后差；抗癫痫药物与生酮饮食疗效有限。rTMS在其他药物难治性癫痫中显示一定前景，但在EMPF1中尚未被探索，本研究旨在报告其在该病中的潜在作用。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为7岁既往健康、发育正常的男孩，表现为右手阵挛性运动伴意识障碍并进展为癫痫持续状态；脑MRI示双侧额、顶、颞叶皮质及基底节、丘脑弥漫性细胞毒性水肿，EEG示广泛周期性棘慢波伴背景变慢，基因检测发现新发DNM1L突变（c.1949T>C，p.Leu650Pro），按ACMG/AMP判为可能致病，支持EMPF1诊断。在抗癫痫药物与代谢“鸡尾酒”治疗基础上，于第16天对左侧初级运动皮质施加1Hz rTMS（90%静息运动阈值，每日40串）。终点为癫痫发作频率的时间变化；摘要未报告正式统计方法。
AI.result: 启动联合治疗后，发作频率呈时间相关性下降：1天后由约20次/日降至5-6次/日，第27天（rTMS启动后12天）降至2-3次/日，第36天（启动后21天）降至0-1次/日。尽管临床发作负担减轻，患儿仍出现进行性肺炎并致脓毒症和急性心力衰竭，于第65天（住院第65天）死亡。摘要未报告95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 本病例中，在标准抗癫痫与代谢“鸡尾酒”治疗基础上加用rTMS与DNM1L相关EMPF1患儿发作频率显著下降存在时间关联，但该关联仅具假设生成意义，不能将发作减少归因于rTMS；需在更大队列中进一步研究。对电生理实践而言，rTMS在此类超罕见线粒体癫痫中的价值尚待验证，且本例最终死于感染与心力衰竭等并发症，提示预后仍差。

背景：线粒体及过氧化物酶体裂变缺陷1型脑病（EMPF1）是一种罕见的严重线粒体疾病，以急性起病的难治性癫痫发作为特征，迅速进展为癫痫持续状态，且预后不良。常规治疗包括抗癫痫药物和生酮饮食，疗效有限。尽管重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在其他形式的耐药性癫痫中显示出前景，但其在EMPF1管理中的潜在作用尚未探索。

病例介绍：一名7岁男孩，既往健康且发育正常，表现为右手阵挛性运动及意识障碍，进展为癫痫持续状态。脑MRI显示弥漫性细胞毒性水肿，累及双侧额叶、顶叶和颞叶皮质、基底节和丘脑。脑电图记录显示广泛性周期性尖慢波放电伴背景慢化。基因检测发现一个新的新发DNM1L突变（c.1949T > C，p.Leu650Pro），根据ACMG/AMP指南分类为可能致病性，为EMPF1的诊断提供了有力支持。除抗癫痫药物和代谢“鸡尾酒”方案外，于第16天在左侧初级运动皮质应用1-Hz rTMS（静息运动阈值的90%，每日40串）。开始此联合治疗后，癫痫发作频率在时间上出现显著减少，从约20次/天降至1天后的5-6次/天，第27天（rTMS开始后12天）降至2-3次/天，第36天（rTMS开始后21天）降至0-1次/天。尽管临床癫痫发作负担减轻，患者出现进行性肺炎导致脓毒症和急性心力衰竭，并于第65天（住院第65天）死亡。

结论：在本病例中，在标准抗癫痫和代谢“鸡尾酒”治疗基础上加用rTMS，与DNM1L相关EMPF1患者的癫痫发作频率显著减少在时间上相关。这种时间关联具有假设生成性，不能将观察到的癫痫发作减少归因于rTMS；需要在更大队列中进一步研究。

title: Advances and challenges in personalized cardiac modeling and simulation for predicting the risk of sudden death from malignant arrhythmias in post-myocardial infarction
summary: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) represents a major global public health challenge, with malignant ventricular arrhythmias being its primary cause. This review focuses specifically on post-myocardial infarction (post-MI) ischemic cardiomyopathy—the most prevalent substrate for malignant ventricular arrhythmias. Current clinical practice predominantly relies on single functional indices, such as left ventricular ejection fraction, for risk stratification. This approach suffers from significant limitations in predictive accuracy, leading to dilemmas in the prophylactic application of implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, including both under-implantation and over-implantation. Personalized cardiac modeling and simulation technology, an advanced embodiment of the digital twin concept in cardiovascular medicine, offers a highly promising non-invasive solution to overcome these limitations. The core of this technology lies in the deep integration of personalized, multi-modal clinical imaging data, particularly late gadolinium enhancement sequences from cardiac magnetic resonance imaging. This enables the precise construction of individualized cardiac anatomical substrates that reflect the spatial distribution of myocardial fibrosis and scar. Building upon this anatomical foundation, multi-scale computational models are established, spanning from microscopic ion channel kinetics and cellular electrophysiological activity to macroscopic tissue conduction properties. These models systematically simulate core pro-arrhythmic factors under pathological conditions, including key ion channel remodeling, the coupling effects of non-myocytes, and alterations in anisotropic conduction properties of myocardial tissue. Ultimately, by implementing programmed electrical stimulation protocols on the computational heart model, the susceptibility to arrhythmias is dynamically assessed, achieving quantitative and visual stratification of an individual's SCD risk. This technological framework not only non-invasively reveals the dynamic electrical instability underlying static anatomical substrates but also demonstrates broad application prospects in understanding complex arrhythmia mechanisms, assisting in clinical therapeutic decision-making, and advancing the shift towards precision medicine models.

summary_zh: 心源性猝死（SCD）是全球主要的公共卫生挑战，恶性室性心律失常是其首要原因。本综述特别聚焦于心肌梗死后（post-MI）缺血性心肌病——这是恶性室性心律失常最常见的基质。当前临床实践主要依赖单一功能指标（如左心室射血分数）进行风险分层。这种方法在预测准确性方面存在显著局限性，导致植入式心律转复除颤器预防性应用陷入困境，包括植入不足和植入过度。个性化心脏建模与仿真技术作为数字孪生概念在心血管医学中的高级体现，为克服这些局限性提供了一种极具前景的无创解决方案。该技术的核心在于深度整合个性化、多模态临床影像数据，尤其是心脏磁共振成像中的晚期钆增强序列。这使得能够精确构建反映心肌纤维化和瘢痕空间分布的个体化心脏解剖基质。在此解剖基础上，建立多尺度计算模型，涵盖从微观离子通道动力学和细胞电生理活动到宏观组织传导特性。这些模型系统模拟病理条件下的核心致心律失常因素，包括关键离子通道重塑、非心肌细胞的耦合效应以及心肌组织各向异性传导特性的改变。最终，通过在计算心脏模型上实施程序电刺激方案，动态评估心律失常易感性，实现个体SCD风险的定量和可视化分层。该技术框架不仅无创地揭示静态解剖基质下潜在的动态电不稳定性，还在理解复杂心律失常机制、辅助临床治疗决策以及推动向精准医学模式转变方面展现出广阔的应用前景。

title: Clinical and Genetic Characteristics of Hereditary Arrhythmias and Cardiomyopathies in the Middle East.
summary: Inherited arrhythmias and cardiomyopathies are leading causes of sudden cardiac death in young individuals. Although global registries and genetic databases have advanced diagnosis and prevention globally, data from the Middle East (ME) remain limited and fragmented. This review synthesizes clinical and genetic evidence on long QT syndrome, catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, Brugada syndrome, arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and dilated cardiomyopathy across the ME. A defining feature of ME cohorts is the high prevalence of consanguinity, which shapes a distinctive genetic and clinical landscape across these conditions. Autosomal recessive inheritance is consistently enriched, producing homozygous genotypes, which frequently manifest as earlier onset and more aggressive clinical phenotypes compared with those in non-ME populations. Population-specific founder variants have been identified across multiple conditions, whereas consanguineous pedigrees have contributed to the discovery of novel disease genes and recessive mechanisms that expand the global genetic landscape of inherited cardiovascular disease. However, a disproportionately high burden of variants of uncertain significance persists across conditions, driven largely by underrepresentation of ME populations in global genomic reference databases. Emerging large-scale genome initiatives such as the Qatar Biobank, the Egyptian Genome Project, and the Greater Middle East Variome offer a viable path toward ancestry-specific variant interpretation. Strengthening regional registries, genomic resources, and family-based screening programs will be essential to improving risk stratification and prevention of sudden cardiac death in the ME.

title: "I Don't Think It Is Fair…There Should be a Solution to Every Problem": Experiences of Individuals with Sudden Arrhythmia Death Syndromes Who Attempt to Obtain Life Insurance.
summary: Sudden Arrhythmia Death Syndromes are a group of heritable genetic conditions that confer risk of sudden cardiac arrest or sudden cardiac death (SCA/SCD) in young, seemingly healthy individuals. Appropriate diagnosis of an SCA/SCD condition allows for guided management and prevents future sudden cardiac arrest and/or death from occurring. However, identification of a genetic predisposition can affect future insurance applications. While the United States' 2008 Genetic Information Non-discrimination Act (GINA) provides protection against genetic discrimination in employment and health insurance, it does not protect against the use of genetic information with regards to life insurance. This study aimed to expand the current understanding of life insurance experiences in the hereditary SCA/SCD community, gather strategies for individuals who wish to attain life insurance, and facilitate the development of life insurance specific patient and provider resources. Participants were recruited through The Sudden Arrhythmia Death Syndromes (SADS) Foundation. Semi-structured interviews were completed with 15 participants who have or are at-risk for SCA/SCD. Thematic analysis captured three themes: Emotional Outlook and Impact, Navigating the System, and Pay It Forward. Our participants with or at-risk for SCA/SCD expressed interest in attaining life insurance coverage that meets their individual needs and invested a meaningful amount of time and effort into their attempts. Most were unsuccessful. They perceived a lack of understanding regarding heritable SCA/SCD conditions by insurance professionals and felt their denials were unfairly attributed to their SCA/SCD diagnosis. Participants shared numerous suggestions for improved approaches to life insurance attainment and educational opportunities.

title: A clinical case of procainamide‑induced Brugada pattern type 1
summary: Brugada syndrome is a hereditary channelopathy associated with a high risk of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias in individuals without structural heart disease. Its prevalence is 1-5 per 10,000 persons, and most patients are asymptomatic; diagnosis of concealed forms is often possible through provocative testing with sodium channel blockers. We report a case of a 53-year-old male patient K., in whom type 2 Brugada-like ECG changes were incidentally detected during an emergency medical services call for nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. A Brugadalike pattern in leads V1-V2 persisted on repeated ECG recordings. After exclusion of coronary artery disease, a procainamide challenge test was performed and yielded a positive result with induction of a type 1 pattern. The patient was referred to a specialized center, where endocardial electrophysiological study (EPS) confirmed a procainamide-induced type 1 Brugada pattern. This case demonstrates the value of a complete twostage diagnostic algorithm for individualized arrhythmic risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 一例53岁男性因消化道症状就诊时偶然发现2型Brugada样心电图，经普鲁卡因胺激发试验诱发出1型Brugada模式，提示药物激发试验在隐匿型Brugada综合征诊断中的价值。

AI.conclusion: 本病例表明，对疑似Brugada综合征患者采用完整的兩阶段诊断流程（药物激发试验联合EPS）有助于明确诊断并指导个体化心律失常风险评估。但作为单例报道，结论外推受限，需更大样本研究验证。

title: Stable truncating mutations in plakophilin-2 induce arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy-like phenotypes in adult zebrafish
summary: Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy (ACM) is an inherited cardiac disorder characterized by arrhythmias and fibrofatty myocardial remodeling, often leading to heart failure and sudden cardiac death. Mutations in plakophilin-2 ( PKP2 ) represent the most prevalent genetic cause of ACM. Here, we establish zebrafish ( Danio rerio ) as a complementary vertebrate model for PKP2 mutation-based ACM. Comparative single-cell RNA-seq analyses revealed distinct cardiac expression patterns of PKP2 and its homologs across species. Using CRISPR-Cas9, we generated two truncating mutations in zebrafish pkp2 , resulting in frameshifts and premature terminations (p.Glu250Glyfs∗17 and p.Glu31Glyfs∗72, respectively). Mutant zebrafish exhibited impaired cardiac contractility, arrhythmias, lipid accumulation on the ventricular surface, ultrastructural abnormalities of intercalated discs, and increased susceptibility to swimming exercise-induced sudden death. Transcriptomic analyses identified transcriptional alterations in genes involved in muscle contraction and lipid metabolism. Together, these data establish zebrafish as a useful complementary vertebrate model for studying PKP2 -based ACM and gene-environment interactions underlying disease progression.

AI.tldr: 研究利用CRISPR-Cas9构建pkp2截短突变斑马鱼，再现ACM表型如收缩力下降、心律失常和运动诱导猝死，支持其作为PKP2相关ACM的补充模型。
AI.motivation: PKP2突变是ACM最常见遗传病因，但现有模型有限，需建立补充脊椎动物模型以研究疾病机制和基因-环境交互。
AI.method: 研究类型为实验性基础研究；对象为斑马鱼；样本量摘要未报告；干预为CRISPR-Cas9生成两种pkp2截短突变（p.Glu250Glyfs*17和p.Glu31Glyfs*72）；终点包括心脏收缩力、心律失常、脂质积累、超微结构及运动诱导猝死；统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 突变斑马鱼出现心脏收缩力受损、心律失常、心室表面脂质积累、闰盘超微结构异常及游泳运动诱导猝死易感性增加；转录组分析显示肌肉收缩和脂质代谢相关基因转录改变；关键统计数值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 斑马鱼pkp2截短突变模型再现ACM关键表型，可作为研究PKP2相关ACM及基因-环境交互的补充脊椎动物模型；但样本量、效应量及统计细节未报告，需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）是一种遗传性心脏疾病，以心律失常和纤维脂肪性心肌重构为特征，常导致心力衰竭和心源性猝死。桥粒斑蛋白-2（PKP2）突变是ACM最常见的遗传原因。在此，我们建立斑马鱼（Danio rerio）作为PKP2突变所致ACM的补充脊椎动物模型。比较单细胞RNA-seq分析揭示了PKP2及其同源基因在不同物种间的心脏表达模式差异。利用CRISPR-Cas9，我们在斑马鱼pkp2中产生了两个截短突变，分别导致移码和提前终止（p.Glu250Glyfs*17和p.Glu31Glyfs*72）。突变斑马鱼表现出心脏收缩力受损、心律失常、心室表面脂质积累、闰盘超微结构异常以及游泳运动诱导的猝死易感性增加。转录组分析确定了参与肌肉收缩和脂质代谢的基因的转录改变。总之，这些数据表明斑马鱼是研究PKP2相关ACM及疾病进展的基因-环境相互作用的有用补充脊椎动物模型。

title: Twenty Years at the Crossroads: Is Clinical Cardiac Electrophysiology Science, Procedure, or Both?
Federated learning with adaptive reliability aware aggregation for privacy preserving healthcare IoT systems
summary: Abstract Healthcare Internet of Things (IoT) devices generate vast amounts of sensitive patient data, creating significant privacy risks and regulatory challenges when processed through centralized architectures. Federated Learning (FL) offers a promising solution by enabling decentralized model training without sharing raw data. However, real-world deployment faces critical challenges including device heterogeneity, intermittent connectivity, non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data, and unreliable node participation. This paper proposes a Reliability-Aware Adaptive Aggregation (RAAA) framework that dynamically evaluates client trustworthiness through three dimensions: update quality (local accuracy and gradient alignment), participation consistency (historical engagement patterns), and communication latency. These metrics are integrated into a composite reliability score using weighted aggregation, which adaptively prioritizes contributions from trustworthy nodes during global model updates. The framework was validated using PhysioNet electrocardiogram (ECG) datasets (MIT-BIH and PTB) with 20 simulated healthcare IoT clients under conditions of node dropout and data heterogeneity. Experimental results demonstrate that RAAA achieved 91.7% classification accuracy on arrhythmia detection, outperforming Federated Averaging (FedAvg) (85.2%), Federated Proximal (FedProx) (86.4%), and Q-FedAvg (87.1%) by 6.5%, 5.3%, and 4.6%, respectively. The proposed method converged 17% faster (43 versus 52 rounds) and maintained an 85.6% client participation rate. Cross-dataset validation on the PTB database confirmed consistent improvements across different physiological signals. The RAAA framework provides a robust, privacy-preserving FL solution for healthcare IoT environments with superior accuracy, faster convergence, and resilience to unreliable nodes. All evaluations are conducted in a simulated environment; while theoretical energy and complexity analyses suggest suitability for resource-constrained edge devices, real-hardware validation remains an important direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 在模拟医疗物联网环境中，RAAA联邦学习框架在心律失常检测中达到91.7%准确率，优于FedAvg等基线，且收敛更快、参与率更高。
AI.motivation: 医疗物联网设备产生大量敏感数据，集中式处理存在隐私风险；联邦学习虽可避免原始数据共享，但实际部署面临设备异质性、间歇连接、非独立同分布数据和节点不可靠等挑战，需要更稳健的聚合策略。
AI.method: 提出可靠性感知自适应聚合（RAAA）框架，从更新质量（本地准确率与梯度对齐）、参与一致性（历史参与模式）和通信延迟三个维度动态评估客户端可信度，加权合成可靠性分数并自适应优先可信节点。使用PhysioNet心电数据集（MIT-BIH和PTB）模拟20个医疗物联网客户端，在节点掉线和数据异质性条件下验证，以心律失常检测分类准确率、收敛轮次和客户端参与率为主要评价指标，并与FedAvg、FedProx、Q-FedAvg比较。
AI.result: RAAA在心律失常检测中分类准确率达91.7%，分别比FedAvg（85.2%）、FedProx（86.4%）和Q-FedAvg（87.1%）高6.5%、5.3%和4.6%；收敛速度快17%（43轮 vs 52轮），客户端参与率维持85.6%；在PTB数据库跨数据集验证中确认了在不同生理信号上的一致改善。
AI.conclusion: RAAA框架为医疗物联网环境提供了一种稳健、隐私保护的联邦学习方案，具有更高准确率、更快收敛和对不可靠节点的韧性；但所有评估均在模拟环境中进行，真实硬件验证是未来重要方向，对电生理实践的直接临床影响尚需进一步研究。

summary_zh: 摘要：医疗物联网（IoT）设备产生大量敏感患者数据，在通过集中式架构处理时会造成显著的隐私风险和监管挑战。联邦学习（FL）通过支持不共享原始数据的去中心化模型训练，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，实际部署面临关键挑战，包括设备异构性、间歇性连接、非独立同分布（non-IID）数据以及不可靠的节点参与。本文提出了一种可靠性感知自适应聚合（RAAA）框架，该框架通过三个维度动态评估客户端可信度：更新质量（本地准确性和梯度对齐）、参与一致性（历史参与模式）和通信延迟。这些指标通过加权聚合整合为综合可靠性评分，在全球模型更新期间自适应地优先考虑可信节点的贡献。该框架使用PhysioNet心电图（ECG）数据集（MIT-BIH和PTB）在节点丢失和数据异构条件下对20个模拟医疗IoT客户端进行了验证。实验结果表明，RAAA在心律失常检测上达到了91.7%的分类准确率，分别比联邦平均（FedAvg）（85.2%）、联邦近端（FedProx）（86.4%）和Q-FedAvg（87.1%）高出6.5%、5.3%和4.6%。所提出的方法收敛速度快17%（43轮对52轮），并保持了85.6%的客户端参与率。在PTB数据库上的跨数据集验证证实了在不同生理信号上的一致改进。RAAA框架为医疗IoT环境提供了一种稳健、隐私保护的FL解决方案，具有更高的准确性、更快的收敛速度和对不可靠节点的韧性。所有评估均在模拟环境中进行；虽然理论能量和复杂度分析表明其适用于资源受限的边缘设备，但真实硬件验证仍是未来工作的重要方向。
